entities.name: Nguyễn Phúc Tần
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nguyễn Phúc Tần was one of the Nguyễn lords who ruled south Vietnam from the city of Phú Xuân from 1648 to 1687. During his rule, the Trịnh–Nguyễn War came to an end. During his reign, he annexed nearly all the remaining Champa lands. Lord Phuc Lan took the title Duong Quan-Cong.
